title: FAUST machine learning finds T-cell correlates of anti-PD-1 response in cytometry data
summary: Applied to a Merkel cell carcinoma anti-PD-1 trial, FAUST found pre-treatment effector memory T cell phenotypes co-expressing PD-1, HLA-DR and CD28 as correlates of outcome. These were validated in cryopreserved PBMC samples from the same study and in an independent CyTOF metastatic melanoma trial. It is a method paper with small trial cohorts and correlative findings.
ai_technology: FAUST, an unsupervised cell-population discovery method for single-cell cytometry

evidence.tested: Cryopreserved PBMC samples from same trial plus independent CyTOF melanoma trial
evidence.unknown: Method paper; small trial cohorts; correlative; full text not reviewed.
